a.lede: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
a.title: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'

b.lede: During his appearance Wednesday at The New York Times' DealBook Summit, Elon Musk said that he wasn't sure what the term "MAGA" meant and also commented that he felt "pretty foolish" for having spent so much money during the U.S. midterms.
b.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’
